title: iPhone 18 Pro Trends: Rising Costs and September Release
description: Recent reports indicate the iPhone 18 Pro will see a significant cost increase and a September launch driven by demand.

sections.heading: Rising Production Costs
paragraphs: According to TrendForce, the Bill of Materials (BOM) cost for the iPhone 18 Pro is expected to surge nearly 40%.
This increase may leave Apple to sacrifice margins to sustain shipments. Additionally, TradingView reports that memory costs are squeezing iPhone margins.

sections.heading: Anticipated Release Window
paragraphs: Forbes reports that demand is driving a September launch for the iPhone 18 Pro.
This release window is supported by supply chain analysis mentioned in the coverage.

sections.heading: Search Interest Data
